description: Workflow dependencies resolve while write-all permissions and a moving action branch are distinguished from read-only, commit-pinned settings.

files..github/workflows/checks.yml:
name: Authored checks fixture
on: push
permissions: write-all
jobs:
  unsafe:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: example/check@main
  safe:
    needs: unsafe
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: read-all
    steps:
      - uses: example/check@1111111111111111111111111111111111111111

notes: The example action and all-ones commit are nonexecuted fixture identifiers. A syntactically pinned hash is a negative control for branch mutability, not an endorsement of an action's trustworthiness.
The dependency edge points from the job declaring needs to its prerequisite.
